gate_options_backgroundCheckHelp.message:
Off by default.

When on: while the active tab is a listed domain and its window has focus, the IP is checked about every 5 seconds. If the tab is hidden or the window loses focus, a fallback alarm checks at the interval below (minimum 30 seconds). The result applies to every site in the list.

When off: the IP is checked only when you open a listed site, on browser startup, or via Check now. Switching to another tab or domain stops automatic checks.

Note: the browser may delay the fallback alarm.

gate_options_domainsHelp.message: Subdomains are covered. Chrome asks for access to each domain.

gate_options_endpointHelp.message: HTTPS only; the body must be the public IPv4 as plain text. Pick a known endpoint or type your own. Fallbacks are used on later checks when this one fails; failed endpoints cool down.

gate_options_fallbacksHelp.message: Each automatic check uses one available endpoint; a failed endpoint cools down and later checks try another. Up to 8. Each enabled endpoint sees your IP. The in-tab check uses only endpoints that allow CORS; others are used by the background check.

gate_options_intervalHelp.message: Fallback alarm interval. Minimum 30 seconds; the browser may delay it. It checks an active listed tab whose window is hidden or unfocused. While the active tab is a visible listed domain with focus, checks run about every 5 seconds.
